procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the five pages are LANDSCAPE-GENUINE (raw ~2420x1870 renders read upright directly, no transpose -- cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/sunflower/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (13/13), the X-celled Circuit 4 rows included (Richard A. Smith 305+1427 = 1732; McCrady 1649+265 = 1914; Carol White Richard 2578+0 = 2578).
structure_note: Same two-table shape as the other Tier-1 five-page sheets: p1 is the certification/signature page (signed Nov 13); p2+p3 = table A over the county's 17 precincts (11 columns, then 44-Ruleville/45-Sunflower 4/51-Ruleville North/52-Sunflower Plantation/53-Rome/54-Drew + TOTAL) carrying the state-office sections and the Chancery 7-2 section; p4+p5 = table B (same column split) carrying the Circuit 4 continuation row and locals. The SEMS row-block split: 'Circuit Court 4-2-Circuit District 4-2' prints as the LAST header box on p2/p3 and its candidate row (Margaret Carey-McCrady) starts p4 (the Warren p5 carry pattern). Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 02-2nd Congressional District (Ron Eller, Bennie G. Thompson, Bennie Foster -- the same House 2 roster, names identical); Court Of Appeals 02-District 2 Position 1 (Deborah A. McDonald); Chancery Court 7-2-Chancery District 7-2 (Willie J. Perkins Sr., W. M. Sanders -- this county's portion of Chancery District 7 elects Place 2, while Quitman/Coahoma's portion elects Place 1 Catherine Farris-Carter: accepted place spread); Circuit Court 4-1-Circuit District 4-1 (Richard A. Smith), Place 2 (Margaret Carey-McCrady), Place 3 (Carol White Richard) -- THREE places, each section X-celled outside its sub-district with values in disjoint precinct groups (Smith: 41-Fairview-Hale, 42-Boyer-Linn, 43-Doddsville, 44-Ruleville, 51-Ruleville North, 52-Sunflower Plantation, 53-Rome, 54-Drew; McCrady: 13/31/32/33-Indianola and 45-Sunflower 4; Richard: 11-Inverness, 12-Moorhead, 21/22-Indianola 2). Printed totals: Colom 5488, Hyde-Smith 1672, Pinkins 83, Eller 1556, G. Thompson 5536, Foster 129, McDonald 6110, Perkins Sr. 3653, Sanders 3176, Richard A. Smith 1732, McCrady 1914, Carol White Richard 2578.
operator_rows_note: All 13 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2 (eleven precinct cells) + p3 (six precinct cells + printed TOTAL); McCrady's and Richard's rows carry p4 + p5 cells + the p5 printed TOTAL. The X-celled rows supply only the numeric cells plus the printed TOTAL -- the X-marked blanks become 0 under the row's own printed TOTAL, the established X-cell rule both pages over.
truncation_note: No truncations; the seventeen precinct headers print complete with the county's SEMS beat codes kept verbatim (11-Inverness, 12-Moorhead, 13-Indianola 1 Southeast, 21-Indianola 2 West, 22-Indianola 2 East, 31-Indianola 3 South, 32-Indianola 3 Southwest, 33-Indianola 3 Northeast, 41-Fairview-Hale, 42-Boyer-Linn, 43-Doddsville, 44-Ruleville, 45-Sunflower 4, 51-Ruleville North, 52-Sunflower Plantation, 53-Rome, 54-Drew).
local_note: p4/p5 carry the local section Yazoo-Mississippi Delta Levee Board-Yazoo Mississippi Delta Levee Commissioner (Charles Modley, Richard G. Noble) -- local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows on operator-supply pages. Circuit 4's three Places print in-county, so the family writes Place-qualified labels; Chancery 7's printed Place on this sheet is 2.

accepted_roster_divergences.note: Disjoint place spread across the district's counties: Sunflower's portion of Chancery District 7 elects Place 2 only (Willie J. Perkins Sr., W. M. Sanders); Quitman's and Coahoma's portions elect Place 1 only (Catherine Farris-Carter, the identical roster both print). Each county keeps its own printed section; per-county TOTAL arithmetic verifies every row.
